visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with a bun and beard, wearing a white tunic, performs a yoga lunge in a forest. His hands are raised above his head as sunlight filters through the dense trees. Colorful prayer flags hang in the foreground, slightly out of focus. (2) Transition to the man sitting in a decorated indoor studio. He wears gold jewelry and a white shirt. The background is filled with traditional rugs, cushions, and wooden items. He speaks with expressive hand gestures while looking at the lens. (3) The man performs yoga on a rooftop under a bright blue sky. Numerous prayer flags flutter in the wind. The flooring is flat and gray. He moves his arms in a wide, circular motion, demonstrating strength and flexibility. (4) A woman with dark hair and a white shirt sits in the same indoor studio. She gestures toward her chest while speaking. The setting remains filled with cultural artifacts and soft lighting. An infographic card with text appears on the side. (5) The woman and another person sit on a brick floor outdoors, practicing breathing exercises. They use their fingers to close their nostrils. The background shows a weathered brick structure and lush greenery. Both wear simple white outfits. (6) Meditating indoors, the man has graphics representing energy centers or chakras overlaid on his torso. Each graphic has a different color and symbol. He sits perfectly still with his eyes closed in a calm, dimly lit environment. (7) A montage shows the man in various yoga poses against a pink-toned wall. In some frames, his image is duplicated or split. He demonstrates balance and precise movements with his limbs. Text highlights his actions at the bottom. (8) The man practices yoga in spectacular natural settings, including a high mountain overlook with snow-capped peaks and a beach at sunset. The lighting varies from bright daylight to warm, golden hour hues. Objects include yoga mats and flags. (9) Both instructors sit together in the indoor studio, facing the camera with welcoming smiles. They hold their hands in a meditative pose. The video ends with a clean white screen featuring a blue and black corporate brand logo.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Peaceful acoustic music begins, featuring strings and a woodwind melody. A male voice narrating in English has a calm, low-pitched, and authoritative tone. The speech rate is moderate and rhythmic, with clear pauses between sentences for emphasis. (2) The acoustic BGM continues with a steady beat. The male voice, Raj, introduces himself. The vocal intensity is conversational and friendly. There is no significant background noise, suggesting a clean studio recording or effective post-production audio filtering. (3) A female voice, Deepa, starts speaking. Her pitch is higher than the male voice but maintains the same calm and professional quality. The music remains at a consistent level, providing a harmonious and meditative atmosphere throughout the narration. (4) The audio features a mix of the two voices talking about yoga principles. The music tempo stays around 85 BPM. There are no sudden sound effects, only the continuous blend of voices and melodic acoustic instruments. The spectral balance is warm. (5) The voices conclude their message with a final invitation. The music reaches a natural resolution point. A soft, digital stinger sound accompanies the appearance of the final logo on the screen. The overall audio quality is high and studio-grade.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional advertisement for a comprehensive yoga course titled 'The Pure Essence of Yoga' offered by SAT.Knowledge. It aims to showcase the expertise of the two traditional instructors from Nepal and the holistic curriculum covering poses, breathwork, and chakras.
